instruction: A candid, clean studio photograph in a medium shot showing two women performing a double high-five against a plain beige backdrop. On the left, the woman with short brown hair (R2) in a striped shirt and beige pants sits facing right, smiling. On the right, the woman with dark curly afro hair (R1) in a purple long-sleeve shirt sits facing left, smiling back. They look at each other with both of their hands extended forward, palms touching in the center. The scene is illuminated by soft, even studio lighting, creating a warm and cheerful mood.
